posts.title: Fixing an Intermittent Left-Half Failure on the Kinesis Advantage360
posts.description: A follow-up to my earlier post on programming a Dvorak layout for the Advantage360. Same keyboard, different problem: the left half of my wired Advantage360 (KB360, SmartSet engine — not the Pro) started dropping out a few times a day. If you’re seeing the same thing, this post is the short version of how I diagnosed it and what fixed it.

posts.title: Dvorak with the Kinesis Advantage360
